decisions.briefing: Markets were neutral today (NASDAQ -0.4%, S&P 500 -0.1%) with no clear risk-on signal. Cash is only $89.29, well below the $500 threshold needed to open a new position, so no buys are possible regardless of candidate strength. Holding all 7 existing positions and letting stop-loss/profit-target rules manage them automatically.

market_education.summary_en: Major indices drifted slightly lower today, with the NASDAQ down 0.4% and the S&P 500 down 0.1%, reflecting a quiet, directionless session rather than any major catalyst. Without a strong risk-on or risk-off signal, the prudent move is to avoid forcing trades and instead wait for clearer confirmation. This kind of low-volatility, mixed-signal day is common and doesn't require portfolio action.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤走勢平淡，納指下跌0.4%，標普500下跌0.1%，未見明顯的利多或利空消息帶動。在缺乏明確風險偏好訊號的情況下，最穩健的做法是按兵不動，等待更清晰的市場方向確認。這類低波動、訊號不明的交易日相當常見，毋須貿然進出。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Cash drag happens when idle cash in a portfolio can't be productively invested — here, only $89.29 is available, far short of the $500 needed to open a new position. Rather than force a trade with insufficient capital, the disciplined approach is to hold and let cash build until a real opportunity and threshold are both met.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「現金拖累」是指投資組合中閒置的現金無法有效運用的情況——目前現金僅有89.29美元，遠低於開新倉所需的500美元門檻。與其勉強用不足的資金交易，更穩健的做法是持有現金，等待資金累積到位、同時出現真正的投資機會時再出手。
